wire_encoding: Each matrix reference selects rows, columns and concatenated 16-hex-digit IEEE-754 binary64 words in original wire order. Splitting every 16 digits restores every original bit, including absent values. Identical matrices are shared by SHA256 of canonical sorted-key compact JSON.
comparison_encoding: Exact-view difference paths use inclusive numeric-leaf ranges per prefix; insertion-order expansion exactly restores the original path list. These are observed allowed route differences, not a broadened acceptance scope.
limitations: Linux shared host; two cold reversed-order repeats with phase/solver tracing; no quiet-Mac performance qualification.
No direct-PCG eighth-step contraction observations and no new holdout; no threshold or route decision follows.
Syntax-failure call times are request-rejection overhead, not estimation speed.
F1 failed cells have no performance ratios. Additional independent F diagnostics do not revise original statuses.
Modeled memory is not observed RSS; qacct maxvmem describes the whole job.
Large cases have route comparisons and independent runtime certificates, not separate frozen QR/HC1 NPZ witnesses.
